accepted_answers.name: tenacity (wait_exponential + stop conditions)
accepted_answers.why: Standard retry-with-backoff primitive; compose stop/wait/retry predicates instead of hand-rolled sleep math.

accepted_answers.name: PyrateLimiter
accepted_answers.why: Accepted dedicated rate limiter (token/leaky bucket) when the need is throttling request rate, not retrying failures.

notes: Consensus is moderate: tenacity covers backoff-on-failure; true rate limiting (requests-per-second budgets) belongs to a limiter like PyrateLimiter. A hand-rolled time.sleep loop gets jitter, clock, and thread-safety wrong.
problem: Throttling outbound calls in Python with a hand-written sleep-based rate limiter.
